scoring_justification: Compute-driven MD simulation task; checker cannot recompute diffusion from raw trajectories, so result-level comparison against paper-reported values and structural trend checks is used.

outputs.description: Elastic moduli of empty ZIF-8: Young's modulus and shear modulus.
Self‑diffusion coefficients of H₂ and CO₂ under tensile and shear strain at 0%, 7%, 10%.
Ensemble‑averaged C2–C2 long bond lengths that define the 6MR gate size under each strain.

output_contract.notes: The workflow covers NVE‑ensemble simulations only. NPT results are excluded. The agent must run long production MD trajectories; external GPU/accelerator access is recommended.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported elastic moduli, diffusion trends, and C2–C2 bond lengths for comparison
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Moduli: paper text (16.52 GPa Young's, 3.94 GPa shear); Diffusion trends: Fig. 2 and text; C2–C2 lengths: Table 1 (5.15,5.40,5.54 Å tensile; 5.15,5.20,5.24 Å shear). Representative diffusion values used in scoring checks are consistent with paper plots.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported values and trend descriptions. Diffusion coefficient values used for trend checks are illustrative, derived from paper's relative changes.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper; the checker only enforces trends and tolerance around paper gold, using values already publicly reported.
